name: Stirling
title: Stirling —
tagline: Where Wallace and Bruce fought and Scotland's past meets the Trossachs.
summary: Stirling sits at the point where Lowlands meet Highlands, and for centuries whoever controlled its castle controlled Scotland. The battles of Stirling Bridge (1297) and Bannockburn (1314) were fought here.
To the west lie the Trossachs and Loch Lomond, known as the 'Highlands in miniature'.
